# Additional prototype sound originals

Acquired 2026-11-07 (Japan time), from the publishers' public download links. These originals are kept unchanged. This is not a claim that all audio in this repository is public domain.

## SoundBible — CC BY 3.0

- **Sword Swing** — Mike Koenig: https://soundbible.com/1176-Sword-Swing.html
  - Original: `SoundBible/Sword_Swing.wav`
  - Download: https://soundbible.com/grab.php?id=1176&type=wav
  - Derivatives: SwordA, SwordB, SwordIai (movement/whiff, with Kenney layers).
- **Swords Collide** — Sound Explorer: https://soundbible.com/1980-Swords-Collide.html
  - Original: `SoundBible/Swords_Collide.wav`
  - Download: https://soundbible.com/grab.php?id=1980&type=wav
  - Current derivative: ParryClang. Current LightHit/HeavyHit instead use Woosh plus Kenney knife sweeps.
- **Swords Clashing** — Mike Koenig: https://soundbible.com/857-Swords-Clashing.html
  - Original: `SoundBible/Swords_Clashing.wav`
  - Download: https://soundbible.com/grab.php?id=857&type=wav
  - Current derivative: ParryClang. Only the first clash is used, not the repeated clash later in the recording.
- **Ninja Samurai Sword** — Mike Koenig: https://soundbible.com/1526-Ninja-Samurai-Sword.html
  - Original: `SoundBible/Ninja_Samurai_Sword.mp3`
  - Download: https://soundbible.com/grab.php?id=1526&type=mp3 (the WAV endpoint returned an empty response; the official MP3 is retained without transcoding).
  - Source history only: removed from the current gameplay derivatives after the user found its cutting texture too realistic.
- **Electricity** — Mike Koenig: https://soundbible.com/1107-Electricity.html
  - Original: `SoundBible/Electricity.wav`
  - Download: https://soundbible.com/grab.php?id=1107&type=wav
  - Retained derivative: CounterCharge (short excerpt, pitch/EQ and Kenney transient layers), one 0.18-second accent. Disabled by default at the user's request; the optional peak-timing path still needs Unity verification. Never looped.
- **Woosh** — Mark DiAngelo: https://soundbible.com/2068-Woosh.html
  - Original: `SoundBible/Woosh.wav`
  - Download: https://soundbible.com/grab.php?id=2068&type=wav
  - Derivatives: Dash (also used quietly for the counter's kick release movement), LightHit and HeavyHit (short blade/air sweeps with Kenney knife layers).
- **Kick** — Mike Koenig: https://soundbible.com/996-Kick.html
  - Original: `SoundBible/Kick.wav`
  - Download: https://soundbible.com/grab.php?id=996&type=wav
  - Source history only: the former CounterImpact body layer is no longer used.
- **Realistic Punch** — Mark DiAngelo: https://soundbible.com/2069-Realistic-Punch.html
  - Original: `SoundBible/Realistic_Punch.wav`
  - Download: https://soundbible.com/grab.php?id=2069&type=wav
  - Current derivative: CounterImpact, a short selected transient with low-frequency rumble removed and CC0 Kenney punch layers. No synthetic explosion or metal layer is used.

Do not imply endorsement or restrict the licensed material beyond the license. Nine distributed derivatives (SwordA/B/Iai, LightHit, HeavyHit, ParryClang, Dash, CounterImpact and the default-disabled CounterCharge) are CC BY 3.0. Their compatibility MP3 copies retain the same license. The project's source-code license does not replace these asset licenses.

Changes: mono mixdown/resampling, selected attack extraction, pitch/tempo, high/low-pass and presence/body EQ, amplitude modulation, optional mixing with CC0 Kenney sounds, short fades, -6 dBFS normalization, PCM16 export. Exact per-layer filters and original/output SHA-256 are in `ThirdParty/PrototypeAudio/manifest.json`, generated by `Tools/Audio/Import-PrototypeSfx.ps1`. ParryReady is a CC0 Kenney bell/glass glint; the original success clang is unchanged.

Required distribution attribution is maintained in `Assets/StreamingAssets/AudioCredits.txt`. Unity includes it in player builds under StreamingAssets. Keep it when redistributing a build, source checkout, or extracted audio. No endorsement by the authors or SoundBible is implied.
